source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 2 May 1930, p. 11 ("Local elections in Ulster: nominations in Derry; rural district returns")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 2 May 1930 p11 'Derry Rural Council', read in the block image (area 5): 'All the foregoing, who are retiring members, are thus re-elected, there being no opposition.'

note: Triennial election of the thirteen divisions of Londonderry (Derry No. 1) rural district, one member each. Every retiring member was nominated and re-elected unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 2 May 1930, p. 11). No division in Co. Londonderry was contested in 1930 (county council: Webb withdrew in Liberties), so there was no poll; the round stays filed on 1930-06-05, a provisional date not confirmed by any paper read. Returned unopposed.
